basis: Continuation from v58, prioritising fairness of source-linked answers and recovery of self-contained paper questions

changes.subject: Maths
changes.issue: Correct a=3 without method was overcredited
changes.resolution: Six-stage source-guided scoring requires integration, antiderivative, endpoints/limits, area condition and reasoned conclusion. Equivalent full interval and doubled-half-interval methods accepted.

changes.subject: Physics
changes.issue: 23.8 N appeared suspicious but is expressly in the accepted 22.5–24 N range
changes.resolution: Keep full credit for 23.8 N. Add precise partial credit for specific diameter/radius/area mistakes: 92 N earns 2, 7.3 N and 610000 N earn 1.

changes.subject: Chemistry
changes.source: AQA AS Chemistry 2020 7404/1 Q02.2 and Q02.3
changes.issue: Two questions were hidden pending original-paper context
changes.resolution: Restored each as a self-contained adaptation with appropriate equipment context; tested valid alternative explanations and rejected irrelevant answers.
changes.caveat: The source PDFs in the November directory retain their original June 2020 printed headings, because the normal summer series was cancelled.

limitations: Verification of original AQA mark total is not a guarantee of exact examiner-equivalent judgement for free-text answers.
The scanner and OCR may still misread written algebra and chemical notation.
Nine source-first entries still need original diagrams, prior part context or reworked self-contained prompts.
The 2015–2025 paper archive is not complete.
next: Audit remaining source-first context dependencies and convert only items that can genuinely stand alone.
Review alternate correct methods and contradiction handling on level-of-response questions.
Verify historical paper source years/series and original mark scheme examples before revising stored answers.
